answers.fact: SPDNet performs best on the PaSC dataset for the handheld testing scenario (PaSC2) with 72.83%.
SPDNet outperforms other methods on the PaSC dataset for the handheld testing scenario (PaSC2) with 72.83%, compared to 68.24% for VGGDeepFace and 60.14% for DeepO2P.
